w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hayden just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Ugly." The Codex keeps it.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/14/8), with 5 wave-4 fought, 11 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 27 → 24 · capped · Craft 11 · Talk 19 · Explore 33 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Jovan returns from the wilds hurt (health 3/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,188 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
✨ CAPSTONE: Commander's Coat. The dead follow orders. The living follow the coat. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
